}\n\nvoid origInitPath(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\nvoid origFW(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, std::vector<unsigned int>& path, size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t k = 0;
